chapter: The Treasure of the Four Skerries

quests.title: Treasure Clue: Twinning Isle

dialogue.t: There's a statue here?
*sigh*...
Hey there, why are you sighing alone at this cavern entrance?
Well, I've been living here lately...
You've been living in a place like this!?
I didn't have a choice! A bunch of actors came to the island and started making a racket all day and all night. I couldn't even sleep because of them... So I found myself a quieter spot.
But then a group of hilichurls came out of nowhere and occupied my resting place. So I had no choice but to brave the elements out here!
*sigh* I swore to myself that if someone could help me, I'd tell them...
Tell them what?
Tell them about a clue to finding the legendary Secret Pirate Treasure! Although I only know a quarter of it...
A quarter of a clue?
You seem like you're here for the treasure too. So, what do you say? Get rid of the hilichurls in there and I'll give you the clue's location.
They say that if you collect all four parts of the clue, you can find the treasure that pirates left behind here!
Well, you have a deal!

dialogue.sit: How did it go? Have you gotten rid of the hilichurls inside?

If you're ready, come look for me on the other side of the reef!
